title: Note Templates
description: Use and create templates for consistent note structures

steps.title: Built-in Templates
steps.description: Notention includes templates for meetings, daily notes, project plans, decisions, and more.

steps.title: Use a Template
steps.description: Type /meeting in quick capture or the editor to insert the meeting template

steps.title: Browse Templates
steps.description: Open Command Palette (Ctrl+K) and search 'Template:' to see all available

steps.title: Create Custom Template
steps.description: Go to Settings → Templates to create your own with placeholders and default properties

steps.title: Create Template
steps.description: Click 'New Template', name it 'Weekly Review', and define the structure

steps.title: Template Variables
steps.description: Use {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}}, {{cursor}} as placeholders that auto-fill on use
